CREATE TABLE "public"."account" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "providerAccountId" text NOT NULL,
  "providerData" json,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "account_provider_check_54adbe83" CHECK ("provider" IN ('EMAIL', 'GOOGLE', 'APPLE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."companion" (
  "archivedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "gender" text DEFAULT 'FEMALE' NOT NULL,
  "greeting" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "systemPrompt" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "companion_gender_check_5dd8b08f" CHECK ("gender" IN ('FEMALE', 'MALE', 'OTHER')),
  CONSTRAINT "companion_status_check_aef30f3b" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'ARCHIVED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."companionAppearance" (
  "age" int4,
  "avatarUrl" text,
  "bodyType" text,
  "clothingStyle" text,
  "companionId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "ethnicity" text,
  "eyeColor" text,
  "hairColor" text,
  "hairStyle" text,
  "height" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "imagePrompt" text,
  "metadata" json,
  "skinTone" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."companionPersonality" (
  "communicationStyle" text,
  "companionId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dislikes" json,
  "empathyLevel" int4 DEFAULT 7 NOT NULL,
  "flirtLevel" int4 DEFAULT 5 NOT NULL,
  "humorLevel" int4 DEFAULT 5 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "interests" json NOT NULL,
  "likes" json,
  "metadata" json,
  "romanceLevel" int4 DEFAULT 5 NOT NULL,
  "traits" json NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."companionVoice" (
  "companionId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "language" text DEFAULT 'en' NOT NULL,
  "pitch" float8 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "settings" json,
  "speed" float8 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "voiceId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."conversation" (
  "companionId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "lastMessageAt" timestamptz,
  "metadata" json,
  "title" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."memory" (
  "accessCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "companionId" int4,
  "confidence" float8 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "conversationId" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamptz,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "importance" int4 DEFAULT 5 NOT NULL,
  "lastAccessedAt" timestamptz,
  "metadata" json,
  "source" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "memory_source_check_8ebab798" CHECK ("source" IN ('USER_MESSAGE', 'ASSISTANT_MESSAGE', 'AI_EXTRACTION', 'USER_INPUT')),
  CONSTRAINT "memory_status_check_b7c57345" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'ARCHIVED', 'DELETED')),
  CONSTRAINT "memory_type_check_b6c8f863" CHECK ("type" IN ('PROFILE', 'PREFERENCE', 'RELATIONSHIP', 'CONVERSATION', 'FACT'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."memoryEmbedding" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dimensions" int4 DEFAULT 1536 NOT NULL,
  "embedding" vector(1536),
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "memoryId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "model" text NOT NULL,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "memoryEmbedding_status_check_2b20bc37" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'READY', 'FAILED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."message" (
  "audioUrl" text,
  "content" text,
  "conversationId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "imageUrl" text,
  "metadata" json,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text DEFAULT 'TEXT' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "message_role_check_ca7958fc" CHECK ("role" IN ('USER', 'ASSISTANT', 'SYSTEM')),
  CONSTRAINT "message_type_check_38ffbfe0" CHECK ("type" IN ('TEXT', 'AUDIO', 'IMAGE', 'SYSTEM'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."session" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "metadata" json,
  "refreshToken" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "avatarUrl" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamptz,
  "displayName" text,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_status_check_3a7c0f48" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'DELETED'))
)
